g.text: ATMOSPHERIC HEATER H-101 - FIRING & AIR SYSTEM
1. Burner management per API 556 / NFPA 85: purge, light-off and trip sequences in BMS (SIS logic).
2. Main fuel SSOVs XV-1021/1022 with vent XV (double block & bleed); all fail closed (vent fails open).
3. Fuel / air cross-limiting: AIC-1022 trims FIC-1025 set point; PIC-1021 low-select vs. minimum fire.
4. Snuffing steam manifold valves located >= 15 m from heater (API 560); one per cell + header boxes.
5. Ducts shown double-line; K-101A/B and K-102A/B are 2 x 100 % (one fan symbol shown per pair).
6. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
7. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
8. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
60.7 MW abs. / 67.4 MW fired; 2-cell cabin, 8 passes, 128 rad.
MAT'L Tubes A335 P9 (9Cr-1Mo); convection P5 / CS studded
H-101 low-low pass flow (any pass) -> trip fue
H-101 low-low fuel gas pressure -> trip fuel
H-101 high-high fuel gas pressure -> trip fuel
H-101 loss of flame (all burners) -> trip fuel
H-101 high-high arch pressure / loss of ID fan
INPUTS: FZLL-1011..1018, TZHH-1020 (CFU-100-PR-PID-004); PZLL/PZHH-1027, BZLL-1028, PZHH-1029 (THIS SHEET)
TRIP: XV-1021/1022 + XV-1026 CLOSE, VENT XV OPEN
